vocabulary.name: Foundational Object Redefinition
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: An existing class of core objects is replaced by a more general or abstract class, designed to absorb complexity or represent phenomena that were previously invisible or ad-hoc.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just 'generalization'; it is a specific replacement of a foundational object to solve a known representational deficit, absorbing prior anomalies into the new object's intrinsic structure.

vocabulary.name: Cross-Domain Unification
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: A new formalism or object is constructed to demonstrate that two or more previously separate conceptual domains are instances of a single, underlying structure, enabling translation and transfer between them.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just finding an analogy; it is building a formal, operational bridge or a common super-structure that makes the analogy rigorous and computationally productive.

vocabulary.name: Surrogate Problem Substitution
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: An intractable problem is solved by replacing it with a different, more tractable problem in a new domain, after establishing a formal implication that a solution to the surrogate problem guarantees a solution to the original.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is distinct from simple reframing; it requires leveraging a pre-existing or newly forged, load-bearing implication chain (e.g., Frey-Ribet) to justify the strategic substitution.

vocabulary.name: Constraint-Driven Solution Forcing
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: A solution is found not by direct construction, but by defining a set of fundamental principles or constraints so restrictive that they collectively determine a unique or very small set of possible solutions.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just 'testing a hypothesis'; it is using abstract principles a priori to carve out the solution space, often before a concrete candidate solution even exists.

vocabulary.name: External Formalism Importation
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: Progress is enabled by importing a mature formal language, a specific theorem, or a computational toolkit from an external discipline, providing necessary structure or leverage that was unavailable internally.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just 'collaboration'; it is the specific act of adopting a pre-packaged, powerful piece of formalism or a load-bearing result from another context to solve a specific blockage.

vocabulary.name: Tacit Pattern Formalization
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: An informal, recurring, or empirically observed pattern of success is made explicit by codifying it into a systematic framework, a formal object, or a named heuristic, making it reliable and transmissible.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just 'discovery'; it is the meta-level act of turning a pattern of discovery or of structure into a first-class object of study or a formal tool itself.

vocabulary.name: Scaffolding with Provisional Structures
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: A theory is advanced by deliberately using concepts or frameworks that are known to be incomplete, non-rigorous, or flawed, treating them as temporary scaffolding to reach a more stable successor structure.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just 'trial and error'; it is the strategic deployment of a known-to-be-imperfect tool, where the nature of its failure provides crucial information for the next step.

vocabulary.name: Parameter Space Internalization
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: A collection of related objects, previously studied individually, is re-conceptualized as a single object (a 'space' or 'family') within the theory, allowing the study of variation and deformation using the framework's own tools.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not just creating a set; it is elevating a collection of objects to the status of a single, first-class object of the same kind as its elements, with its own geometric or categorical structure.

vocabulary.name: Systematic Vocabulary Lifting
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: An entire apparatus of concepts and operations from an established theory is systematically reconstructed within a new, more general setting, preserving the relational structure of the original.
vocabulary.what_distinguishes_this_from_a_paraphras: This is not importing a single tool (tb_05), but a wholesale, systematic translation of an entire framework's vocabulary and machinery into a higher-level context.

vocabulary.name: Self-Referential Encoding
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: Encode the system's own description (axioms, formulas, machines) into objects of the system itself, so meta-level statements become object-level expressions; this permits internal reasoning about what the system can and cannot do.

vocabulary.name: Limitative Theorem Construction
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: Use a constructed self-referential or diagonal object to derive a structural impossibility within the framework — establishing a permanent limit (incompleteness, undecidability, unsolvability) rather than a positive theorem.

vocabulary.name: Problem Boundary Specification
vocabulary.structural_mechanism: Make precise what counts as a solution / member / instance of the central question — fixing the success criterion so that 'solvable' or 'computable' or 'provable' has determinate meaning before the main argument runs.

moves.name: Stating the Core Principle
moves.signature: An initial, powerful, and general rule is presented as the basis for a system.
moves.anchor: Naive set theory... allowed arbitrary properties to define sets.

moves.name: Constructing a Counterexample
moves.signature: A specific instance is created using the system's own rules that reveals a fundamental inconsistency.
moves.anchor: Russell showed... that the property 'is not a member of itself' produces a contradiction

moves.name: Articulating the Paradox
moves.signature: The self-referential or contradictory nature of the counterexample is explicitly stated.
moves.anchor: the set R... is a member of itself iff it is not.

moves.name: Shifting to Formalism
moves.signature: A response to a flaw is initiated by moving from a general, intuitive principle to a set of explicit, formal rules.
moves.anchor: Zermelo... responded by axiomatizing set theory

moves.name: Replacing General Principle
moves.signature: A single, overly permissive rule is swapped out for a curated list of more constrained, specific rules.
moves.anchor: replacing 'every property defines a set' with a specific list of axioms

moves.name: Bounding New Creation
moves.signature: A new rule is introduced that requires new entities to be formed only from components of existing, well-defined entities.
moves.anchor: Separation restricts comprehension to subsets of an existing set

moves.name: Forbidding Recursive Structures
moves.signature: A rule is added to explicitly prohibit the kind of self-containing loop that caused the original paradox.
moves.anchor: regularity excludes self-membership chains

moves.name: Achieving System Stability
moves.signature: The new set of rules is shown to successfully prevent the previously identified contradiction.
moves.anchor: a formal system that avoided the paradox

moves.name: Preserving Useful Structure
moves.signature: The solution is designed to keep the valuable and functional parts of the old system intact.
moves.anchor: preserving most of Cantorian set theory

moves.name: Establishing New Foundation
moves.signature: The revised system becomes the new standard upon which future work is built.
moves.anchor: ZF became the de facto foundation for 20th-century math.

mappings.reason: Presenting naive comprehension is setup rather than a theory-building operation in the vocabulary.
Russell's set is a constructed self-referential object used to expose a structural impossibility in the system.
Explicitly stating the contradiction is part of deriving the limitative inconsistency, though it is not a separate construction.
Axiomatization responds by replacing intuition with restrictive formal constraints on allowable set formation.
The permissive comprehension principle is replaced by a constrained axiom system that narrows possible constructions.
Separation is a restrictive constraint that forces new sets to arise only within already given sets.
Regularity adds a fundamental constraint designed to rule out self-membership pathologies.
Avoiding the paradox is the stabilizing effect of the restrictive axioms rather than a distinct operation.
Retaining Cantorian results is a design goal of the repair, not a close match to any listed operation.
Becoming the standard foundation is an outcome of the theory-building process rather than one of the specified operations.

moves.name: Establish One Boundary
moves.signature: Demonstrate that a proposition is compatible with an axiomatic system, defining one side of a possibility space.
moves.anchor: Gödel had shown CH is consistent with ZFC

moves.name: Isolate The Converse Problem
moves.signature: Frame the central challenge as determining if the converse of an established compatibility is also true.
moves.anchor: The reverse direction — CH not provable from ZFC — was open

moves.name: Introduce Novel Construction Method
moves.signature: Develop a new, systematic procedure for generating alternative structures that conform to a base set of rules.
moves.anchor: Cohen introduced forcing: a method for constructing models of ZFC

moves.name: Augment A Base Model
moves.signature: Systematically extend a foundational structure with a new, carefully chosen element to create a new, larger structure.
moves.anchor: adjoining a 'generic' filter to a poset

moves.name: Engineer A Specific Outcome
moves.signature: Design the construction process to guarantee that a particular proposition is either true or false in the resulting structure.
moves.anchor: in a controlled way that makes the new model satisfy or violate specified statements

moves.name: Construct The Counter-Model
moves.signature: Apply the new method to produce a concrete example where a key proposition, previously shown to be possible, is now demonstrably false.
moves.anchor: The forcing argument constructs a model where CH fails.

moves.name: Synthesize Opposing Instances
moves.signature: Juxtapose a structure where a proposition holds with one where it fails to prove the proposition's independence from the underlying axioms.
moves.anchor: Combined with Gödel's L showing CH holds, this proved CH is independent of ZFC.

moves.name: Generalize The Technique
moves.signature: Abstract the novel method from its initial application, transforming it into a versatile tool for a broader class of problems.
moves.anchor: Forcing generalized: it became the main technique

moves.name: Expand Application Domain
moves.signature: Deploy the generalized technique to resolve open questions in adjacent or related fields.
moves.anchor: applied to axiom of choice variants, large cardinals, and many descriptive set-theoretic questions

mappings.reason: This is a one-sided relative-consistency result, not a redefinition, encoding, import, or boundary-specification operation in the listed sense.
It fixes the target criterion for the later argument: show ZFC does not decide CH by establishing the reverse consistency direction.
The move invents a model-construction technique, but the vocabulary has no general operation for novel method creation absent import, scaffolding, or tacit-pattern formalization.
Adjoining a generic filter is a specific construction step, not a listed structural operation such as parameter-space internalization or foundational redefinition.
The forcing setup chooses conditions and generic data so that constraints control which statements hold in the resulting model.
Producing a model where CH fails is central to independence, but it is not a self-referential or diagonal limitative construction as specified by tb_11.
The independence conclusion is limitative in outcome, but the operation is model comparison rather than the self-referential or diagonal construction required by tb_11.
Abstracting forcing into a reusable framework partly resembles codifying a successful pattern, though it was not merely tacit or empirical beforehand.
Applying forcing to further set-theoretic questions is downstream deployment rather than one of the listed theory-building operations.

moves.name: Identify A Descriptive Gap
moves.signature: Articulate a class of phenomena that an existing formal system fails to adequately model.
moves.anchor: Coastlines, mountains, blood vessels, cotton prices, and clouds resisted description by Euclidean geometry

moves.name: Generalize A Metric
moves.signature: Adapt an existing quantitative measure to a broader class of cases by relaxing one of its core constraints.
moves.anchor: extending Hausdorff-Besicovitch dimension to non-integer values

moves.name: Characterize The Irregular
moves.signature: Apply a novel descriptive framework to phenomena previously considered outside the scope of formal analysis.
moves.anchor: natural objects often have characteristic non-integer dimensions

moves.name: Isolate A Core Principle
moves.signature: Identify and name a fundamental, recurring structural property that explains a system's behavior across different scales.
moves.anchor: introduced self-similarity (the same shape recurs at all scales)

moves.name: Propose A Canonical Form
moves.signature: Designate a pure, idealized example that perfectly embodies the new conceptual framework.
moves.anchor: named the Mandelbrot set as the canonical example

moves.name: Unify Disparate Phenomena
moves.signature: Demonstrate that a single underlying mechanism can explain a wide range of previously unconnected observations.
moves.anchor: unified disparate empirical observations... under a single mathematical framework

moves.name: Repurpose An Existing Tool
moves.signature: Reframe a problem by recognizing that a known but overlooked tool provides the correct descriptive language for it.
moves.anchor: a recognition that an existing mathematical tool... was the right description

moves.name: Enable Cross-Domain Application
moves.signature: Show how a new conceptual model opens up practical uses and analytical approaches in multiple, distinct fields.
moves.anchor: Applications spread to physics, biology, finance, computer graphics

mappings.reason: Diagnosing a mismatch between Euclidean geometry and natural forms is a motivating gap, not one of the listed structural operations.
Extending dimension beyond integers redefines a core geometric measure to cover a broader class of objects.
Fractal description replaces the Euclidean object class with a more general class able to represent previously ad-hoc irregular phenomena.
Self-similarity codifies a recurring informal visual pattern into an explicit named structural principle.
Selecting the Mandelbrot set as an ideal exemplar is not covered by any listed operation.
A single fractal framework is used to treat many formerly separate empirical domains as manifestations of a common structure.
The move imports or repurposes an existing mathematical apparatus as the descriptive language for a new class of phenomena.
Spreading applications across fields is a consequence of the framework rather than a distinct listed theory-building operation.

moves.name: Establish Foundational Duality
moves.signature: Identify a core, bidirectional mapping between two distinct conceptual domains that underpins the existing paradigm.
moves.anchor: a compact Hausdorff space is determined by its C*-algebra of continuous functions

moves.name: Isolate a Limiting Assumption
moves.signature: Identify a core property of a framework that is violated by an important external phenomenon, revealing the framework's boundary.
moves.anchor: Quantum mechanics introduced noncommutative algebras naturally.

moves.name: Generalize by Abstraction
moves.signature: Redefine a category by removing a limiting property, treating the new, broader class of objects as first-class citizens.
moves.anchor: study NONCOMMUTATIVE C*-algebras as if they were function algebras on 'noncommutative spaces,' even when no underlying point set exists

moves.name: Construct an Analogous Tool
moves.signature: Develop a new tool in the generalized domain that serves the same functional role as a key tool in the original domain.
moves.anchor: He developed cyclic cohomology as a noncommutative analog of de Rham cohomology

moves.name: Define a General Object
moves.signature: Formulate a new, more general definition for a fundamental object that mirrors the structure of its specialized predecessor.
moves.anchor: defined spectral triples (algebra + Hilbert space + Dirac operator) as noncommutative Riemannian manifolds

moves.name: Apply to External Domain
moves.signature: Apply the newly developed abstract framework to explain or derive a known result in a seemingly unrelated field.
moves.anchor: applied the framework to the standard model of particle physics

moves.name: Derive Known Structure
moves.signature: Demonstrate that a complex, empirically known structure can be generated from the fundamental principles of the new system.
moves.anchor: deriving its action functional from spectral data on a specific noncommutative space

moves.name: Subsume the Predecessor
moves.signature: Demonstrate that the original, more constrained system is a special case of the new, more general framework.
moves.anchor: absorbs ... Riemannian geometry (commutative case) ... as instances of the same theory

moves.name: Unify Disparate Fields
moves.signature: Show that the new framework can model and integrate phenomena from multiple, previously disconnected fields under a single conceptual roof.
moves.anchor: absorbs both Riemannian geometry ... and quantum statistical mechanics

mappings.reason: The Gelfand-style duality identifies topology and commutative C*-algebras as two presentations of one underlying structure.
Noting that commutativity is a boundary condition exposed by quantum mechanics is a diagnostic move rather than one of the listed theory-building operations.
It replaces spaces with the broader foundational class of possibly noncommutative C*-algebras treated as generalized spaces.
Cyclic cohomology reconstructs a de Rham-like cohomological apparatus in the noncommutative setting.
Spectral triples redefine Riemannian manifolds as a more general algebraic-operator structure.
Using the framework on the standard model is an application/export of the theory, not clearly one of the specified operations.
The standard-model action is obtained from restrictive spectral data, resembling solution forcing by structural constraints.
Showing commutative Riemannian geometry as a special case is part of replacing the old object-class with a broader one.
The framework integrates Riemannian geometry and quantum statistical mechanics as instances under one noncommutative-geometric structure.
